scope: RoboLab-only design brief. No scene modifications, new experiments, simulator upgrades, or release.
picture_checklist_is: Suggested human design handoff, not an additional frozen experimental requirement.
paper_caveat: RoboLab Figure 9 is a success-conditioned pose-distance posterior for pi-family models on two banana tasks. Appendix B mixes translation and orientation. A 0.50 m translational pickup target with fixed orientation is an engineering proposal, not a measured N3/D1 optimum or a causal SGW finding.

rows.neutral_start: Cube/bowl centers aligned in robot-left-right coordinate within 5 mm; separated front-to-back; cube supported.
rows.goal_a: Put the Rubik's cube to the left of the bowl.
rows.goal_b: Put the Rubik's cube to the right of the bowl.
rows.goal_margin: Cube center at least 30 mm left or right of bowl center in robot frame.
rows.proposed_design_pictures: Neutral start; proposed left endpoint; proposed right endpoint; optional annotated top view.
rows.main_design_priority: Grasp clearance and clear landing routes on both sides; avoid table edge and bowl.

rows.neutral_start: Cube/bowl centers at same height within 5 mm; separate grounded supports; bowl at intermediate height.
rows.goal_a: Put the Rubik's cube higher than the bowl.
rows.goal_b: Put the Rubik's cube lower than the bowl.
rows.goal_margin: Released cube center at least 30 mm higher/lower than bowl center.
rows.proposed_design_pictures: Neutral start; proposed higher endpoint; proposed lower endpoint; annotated side elevation.
rows.main_design_priority: Grounded upper/lower supports; arm clearance; transport path avoids bowl.

rows.neutral_start: Cube equally distant in 3D from bowl and plate centers within 5 mm difference; supported, distinct visible anchors.
rows.goal_a: Put the Rubik's cube closer to the bowl than to the plate.
rows.goal_b: Put the Rubik's cube farther from the bowl than from the plate.
rows.goal_margin: Requested cube-to-anchor distance advantage at least 30 mm.
rows.proposed_design_pictures: Neutral start; near-bowl endpoint; near-plate endpoint; annotated top view and side view if heights differ.
rows.main_design_priority: Recognizable plate, stationary anchors, separate safe supported landing regions.
